Chapter 6898: Solidarity

Chapter 6898: Solidarity

All eyes were on Controller. Devouring Abyss and Fallen Ten clearly wanted to obey Guangmai no matter what.

The representatives of Dark Realm were more independent. Perhaps this was why they survived all the major conflicts.

The ten vagrant immortals weren’t fully united either. They had their own agenda without special love for Stygian, only following the flow when required.

As for the weaker cultivators, they had no choice but to obey.

“It’s fine, wait until we get the heart.” Guangmai smiled.

“Very well, let’s rebuild our world.” Fire Immortal became impatient.

“We will follow you, our leader. Our lives and blood are yours.” Heavenly Devil, one of the ten vagrant immortals, didn’t wish to fall behind.

The other immortals repeated the same thing, not choosing to wait like the three messengers. The reason was that if they were to hesitate, they wouldn’t get a big part of the new world. Being kicked out of the inner circle meant being relegated to remote regions with limited resources and life forms.

The other overlords also did the same, attempting to curry favor.

This made the messengers and the five stars anxious. They stared at Controller because a longer delay meant losing resources later. The group consisted of three golden immortals and five immortals; they needed ample resources.

Given the circumstances, although Controller still had doubts, he nodded: “We are willing to follow you and activate the formation when necessary.”

“Very well.” Guangmai stood up from his throne after receiving everyone’s promise.

“We formalize our promise today.” He raised a cup and said: “Brothers in life and death, in flesh and blood, in the glories of Devouring Alliance.”

“In life and death, in flesh and blood!” The crowd shouted and drank their cup in one go.

“Go.” Guangmai’s particles scattered across Stygian, painting a beautiful scene in the night.

He raised his hand and pulled the staff out of the dark ocean. His Dark Light coiled around it and channeled power into him.

“I hereby solemnly swear that I and my brethren from Devouring Alliance shall be as one in life and death and in flesh and blood for all eternity, for we are connected through authority.” Guangmai swore and channeled flesh and blood into the staff.

This was a formal ceremony activating the grand momentum of Stygian. This was the process of using Stygian’s ultimate ace card - High Heaven Obliteration. This was all to ensure their possession of the world’s heart.

The others repeated the vow and channeled parts of themselves into authority.

In just a short time, those who had accepted the darkness sent their powers and life back into the staff. This was a magnificent scene akin to countless dragons returning to the lair.

Controller had a bad feeling about this and regretted his decision. Alas, it was too late to change his mind.

This had happened once during Guardian Alliance’s last invasion. Zhao Dachui swore first and channeled his life and vitality before having control of the staff.

Its master, Mang, was preoccupied with Immortal Emperor Min Ren. Since everyone saw Zhao Dachui’s initiative, they banded together and repelled Guardian Alliance with haste. Otherwise, they would have been overwhelmed since Golden World’s army was incoming.

This firmly established Zhao Dachui’s position in the alliance, allowing him to rule uncontested.
